brief:
Draw, extend, and render the engraving ornaments of the Privacymage Grimoire (Selene's Spellbook): the nine glyphs, the two figure engravings, and the promise-theoretic sparkle field. Use when adding or editing a glyph or engraving, building the ornament proof sheet, or keeping new poem art in the same hand. Encodes the three-grey palette, the line-weight law, polarity-as-promise (the `+`/`−` sparkle ratio), the new-glyph and new-engraving protocols, the cross-references to plant, and a function template. The generator is ReportLab/Python; the visual canon is the book's STYLE_GUIDE.md.

> The work lives in two greys and the white of the page. Everything else is restraint.

The art generator of *Selene's Spellbook*, first built as a claude.ai artifact and reconstructed locally so the ornaments can be rendered, edited and extended in step with the poems. It is the executable form of the book's `STYLE_GUIDE.md`: the guide is the single visual source; this skill executes it. New ornaments extend the guide (§9/§10); they never start a parallel style.
